newsitem.title: JAPAN: Comson shares climb on note payments.
newsitem.headline: Comson shares climb on note payments.

text.p: Shares of Comson Corp, a small machinery manufacturer, climbed on Friday morning, encouraged by news that it had completed payments of promissory notes due on Thursday.
As of 0106 GMT, the share price was up 14 yen at 59 yen, after having been bid-only at the opening.
Comson shares have been depressed in recent weeks by worries over the firm's financial difficulties.
Comson President Toshimi Matsuda said on Wednesday that the company was having trouble raising 100 million yen to cover promissory notes due on Thursday.
